paragraphs.text: The Source Material Cards bonus sheet is a collection of twenty additional cards released alongside Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles on March 6, 2026. It contains reprinted cards with iconic illustrations from the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise, including by comic book artist and series creator Kevin Eastman . While the set has an expansion symbol, that symbol is not printed on any of the cards in the bonus sheet. The set uses the PZA expansion code, which can be read as "Pizza".
These source material cards are Commander -, Legacy -, and Vintage -legal. Individual cards are also legal where already available in other formats.
